A '''member''' of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who was considered to be eccentric hired the notorious [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Riegenn Hetuu]]<ref name="Codex" /> around [[3743 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> to locate a live [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]], a creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Hetuu's client held a [[Unidentified annual gladiatorial tournament|gladiatorial tournament]] [[Standard year/Legends|annually]] on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and the Hutt intended for the queen to be the highlight of the tournament. However, when Hetuu arrived to deliver the creature, the Hutt and Hetuu were both [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the hunter opened his cargo bay: around four hundred k'lor'slugs which the queen had spawned poured out and ate them both. The incident inspired the term "a [[Hutt's cry]]," a reference to the sound made by a swarm of k'lor'slugs.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt was first mentioned in the Codex entry for k'lor'slugs in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
